intro.fr: Three Goblin Wobblin' se joue en multiworld Archipelago grâce à un APWorld communautaire, distribué hors de l'installation officielle.
intro.en: Three Goblin Wobblin' can be played in an Archipelago multiworld through a community APWorld, distributed outside the official install.

text.fr: Cutting Edge Entertainment sort Three Goblin Wobblin' en 2024.
text.en: Cutting Edge Entertainment releases Three Goblin Wobblin' in 2024.

text.fr: Création du dépôt GitHub melenehh/Three-Goblin-Archipelago, qui héberge l'APWorld de Three Goblin Wobblin'.
text.en: The GitHub repository melenehh/Three-Goblin-Archipelago, home of the Three Goblin Wobblin' APWorld, is created.

text.fr: Publication de la première version, v0.0.1-alpha.
text.en: The first version, v0.0.1-alpha, is released.

text.fr: Publication de la version v0.0.3 alpha Teleporter Update, la plus récente au 21 octobre 2026 (3 versions publiées).
text.en: Version v0.0.3 alpha Teleporter Update is released, the latest as of October 21, 2026 (3 versions released).

text.fr: Three Goblin Wobblin' figure dans le tableur communautaire des APWorlds, qui recense les mondes jouables hors de l'installation officielle d'Archipelago.
text.en: Three Goblin Wobblin' is listed in the community APWorlds spreadsheet, which tracks the worlds playable outside the official Archipelago install.
